_meta.source: Strathearn, Lovett & Kirton, 'Efficient non-Markovian quantum dynamics using time-evolving matrix product operators', Nat. Commun. 9, 3322 (2018), arXiv:1711.09641 — Fig. 3(a), page 5
_meta.panel: (a) spin-1 Ohmic spin-boson model, <Sz> vs t, K=80; initial state <Sz>=+1; omega_c=5, units of Omega

calibration.render: pdftoppm -r 400 dpi, scale S=400/72 px/pt; pdftotext -bbox coords in pt, origin top-left

_meta.method: nearest-palette classification (L1<90, channel spread>30 to reject gray AA) + per-column gap clustering + median + continuity tracking (<0.09); solid-vs-dashed via horizontal persistence score (window +-25 col, thr 0.85)

caveats.dashed_fits: for t beyond solid_t range the series follows the paper's dashed exponential fits A*exp(-gamma*t)+C (fitted to the data), not raw TEMPO data
caveats.legend_box: semi-transparent legend (x 261-300pt, y 83-130.5pt) occludes curves; alpha=0.2 dashed recovered via alpha-blend color (0.357*c+0.643*255); gaps behind legend text glyphs
caveats.start: all curves start at (t=0, <Sz>=1); first ~0.2-0.8 t occluded by mutual line overlap (bundle), so digitized series begin at first visible pixels
caveats.blue_gray_contamination: gray AA pixels of tick labels matched brown (140,86,75) with loose tolerance; rejected by spread filter
